content.user_title: Calculate Japanese Rokuyo for Calendar Dates
content.value_statement: Finding the rokuyo for a Gregorian date requires a lunar calendar conversion. This skill supplies an offline table and calculation rules for supported dates.
actual_capabilities: Convert supported Gregorian dates into lunar month and day using embedded month-start dates.
Calculate all six rokuyo labels using the lunar month plus lunar day modulo six.
Handle leap months by reusing the preceding lunar month number.
Explain results with the Gregorian date, lunar date, and calculation.
Identify dates outside the supported range instead of estimating results.
Perform table-based calculations without network access, API keys, or login.
limitations: Supported dates run from December 1, 2024, through December 27, 2027; later dates require updated calendar data.
Rokuyo is a traditional fortune indicator without a scientific basis and cannot predict outcomes.
Holiday lookup and Japanese era conversion require separate skills named japan-holidays and wareki.
The referenced shared response checklist is not included in this single-file package.

use_cases.title: Compare ceremony dates
use_cases.description: Check rokuyo labels for proposed ceremony dates while keeping availability and personal preferences central.

use_cases.title: Understand Japanese calendar entries
use_cases.description: Translate a Gregorian date into its lunar date and explain the corresponding rokuyo calculation.

use_cases.title: Check calendar annotations
use_cases.description: Calculate rokuyo for dates in the supported range to review labels in schedules or calendar drafts.

prompt_templates.title: Check one date
prompt_templates.prompt: What is the rokuyo for September 11, 2026?
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: get a single calendar label.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the calculation
prompt_templates.prompt: Calculate the rokuyo for September 11, 2026. Show the lunar month, lunar day, and modulo-six calculation.

prompt_templates.title: Compare candidate dates
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare rokuyo for September 11, 12, and 13, 2026. Include lunar dates and explain why these labels should not determine important decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Check leap months and boundaries
prompt_templates.prompt: Calculate rokuyo for July 25, 2025, and December 27, 2027. Explain leap-month handling and reject January 1, 2028, without guessing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: review leap-month logic and date-range limits.

output_examples.input: What is the rokuyo for September 11, 2026?
output_examples.output: September 11, 2026, is lunar month 8, day 1. The calculation is (8 + 1) modulo 6 = 3, giving Tomobiki.

output_examples.input: What is the rokuyo for July 25, 2025?
output_examples.output: July 25, 2025, begins leap lunar month 6, day 1. Leap months reuse month number 6, so the remainder is 1: Shakkou.

output_examples.input: What is the rokuyo for January 1, 2028?
output_examples.output: January 1, 2028, is outside the supported range: December 1, 2024, through December 27, 2027. Consult the official almanac; no estimate is provided.

best_practices: Provide a complete Gregorian date, including the year, and confirm it falls within the supported range.
Request the lunar month and day alongside the rokuyo label to make the calculation traceable.
Treat rokuyo as traditional reference information and prioritize practical considerations for important decisions.
anti_patterns: Requesting estimated results outside the embedded table range.
Reusing a previous year's rokuyo label for the same Gregorian month and day.
Treating rokuyo as scientific evidence or the sole reason for an important decision.

faq.question: Which AI tools are listed as supported?
faq.answer: The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. The skill provides Markdown instructions and an embedded calendar table.

faq.question: Does calculation require internet access or an API key?
faq.answer: No. Supported dates use the embedded lunar calendar table without network access, login, or an API key.

faq.question: What dates are supported?
faq.answer: The supported range is December 1, 2024, through December 27, 2027, inclusive. Outside dates should be reported as unsupported.

faq.question: How are leap lunar months handled?
faq.answer: A leap month uses the preceding month's number. Leap month 6 therefore uses 6 in the modulo-six calculation.

faq.question: Does this skill calculate holidays or Japanese era dates?
faq.answer: No. The source directs holiday questions to japan-holidays and Japanese era conversion questions to wareki.

faq.question: Can rokuyo predict whether an event will succeed?
faq.answer: No. Rokuyo has no scientific basis and should not be the sole basis for important decisions.
